newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent edges down, limited downside seen.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent edges down, limited downside seen.

text.p: August Brent futures were still untraded in late trading on Friday, but prices were marked down in line with a slightly weaker NYMEX market.
August Brent was quoted on SIMEX at $17.85/$17.96 per barrel in late trading, with prices marked lower than midday's $17.84/$18.00 per barrel. September was down three at $18.02.
Brokers said the downside on Friday might be limited, although the medium term trend remained down.
They said in the absence of fresh news, the market was technically oversold which might prompt some preweekend covering in London.
NYMEX August crude was last traded on ACCESS at $19.17 per barrel, down five cents from New York.
